WITHDRAWN_AT_PASS_158.so_what_is_true: whether a softmax fix brings the arm inside the bar is UNMEASURED and the honest answer is that nobody knows. It is not established that it does not. The decision I framed at pass 157 -- 'not a release-gate case on training parity' -- rested on the withdrawn claim and is withdrawn with it.
WITHDRAWN_AT_PASS_158.the_general_error: a per-section extrapolation is only valid where the sections are independent. In a residual stack every section's gradient carries the cotangent of everything downstream, so 'this lever does not touch section X' needs to be a measurement, not an inference from where the lever's code sits.
WITHDRAWN_AT_PASS_158.the_one_direct_measurement: of3t-adaln widened its block arm to all 19 parameters with a 1:1 checkpoint tensor: the whole block under an exact softmax reads mass-weighted 1.489217e-02 -- INSIDE the 2.0e-02 bar -- against 7.856040e-01 shipped. Caveat the row states itself: one block under a CONTROLLED cotangent, where the whole-arm figure is 547 tensors under the real cotangent over 48 samples, and the difference between them is again the cotangent.
WITHDRAWN_AT_PASS_158.what_is_withdrawn: this file's headline -- 'NO softmax lever brings the diffusion arm inside the bar' -- and the 0.1867 figure read as a post-fix floor. WITHDRAWN.
WITHDRAWN_AT_PASS_158.what_the_number_actually_is: 0.1867 is an UPPER BOUND on the post-fix arm, not an estimate of it.
WITHDRAWN_AT_PASS_158.why: the extrapolation held the non-attention 23.8917 % fixed at 0.1855 on the assumption that a softmax lever cannot touch it. of3t-adaln's amendment-6 arm disproves the assumption: run ALONE against upstream 0.4.3's own ConditionedTransitionBlock in float64 on the real (a, s) captured by a pre-hook on THEIR module, the transition reads mass-weighted 5.468736e-03 at block 8, 7.278610e-03 at block 9 and 9.595681e-03 at block 0, with 0 of 9 parameters over the per-tensor bar and cosines at or above 0.99997. Its own K is 17.4 to 35.8 and it would need K near 1.2e+03 to reach the 0.1828 the model shows. So the transition's error is NOT made inside the transition -- it is carried in by the cotangent arriving at its output, which comes from the blocks above, and those contain attention softmaxes. A stack is sequentially coupled; I treated its sections as independent.

extrapolation_SUPERSEDED.caveat: the factors are of3t-adaln's BLOCK-ARM measurements with a generic cotangent, applied here to model-scope rels. That is an extrapolation and is labelled as one everywhere it appears; the row's own DOESNOT says how 55x at one block composes over 24 blocks and 48 samples is not established.

headline: The softmax is confirmed as the dominant defect -- it owns 27.2441 % of the model at mass-weighted rel 10.3684. But NO softmax lever brings the diffusion arm inside the bar, because the other 23.8917 % sits at 0.1855 and is untouched by any of them. Even an EXACT softmax leaves the arm at 0.1867, which is 9.3x the 2.0e-02 mass-weighted bar.

the_decision_the_row_handed_the_orchestr.recommendation: SPLIT THE TWO CASES, because they have different strengths and only one of them is strong. (a) As a TRAINING-PARITY lever the case is weak and should not be taken to the release gate on its own: no softmax lever reaches the bar, and even the float64 bound leaves the arm 9.3x outside it. (b) As an INFERENCE-ACCURACY finding it is unmeasured and possibly strong -- the shipped softmax carries 2.274755e-02 relative error on the inference path at [1,16,384,384] and a kernel config improves that 33x. That deserves a fold-level measurement in Angstrom against the seed floor, not a rel number, and it is cheap.
